# Lost-runner fixtures

The 172201, 172202, and 172203 records are synthetic fixtures for dotfiles#1722.
They are not raw GitHub API captures. Their job names, failed-step names, and
timing/order model acme-app run 38107443386 attempt 1 (2026-10-11). Aggregate
messages were checked against the two aggregate job logs. The leaf annotation
models the documented lost-communication contract; its raw annotations could
not be retrieved through the available connector. IDs and head identity are
deliberately synthetic. The pre-existing 111... fixtures retain their original
recorded provenance.
